remarks: LOCATION! LOCATION! LOCATION! Experience city living & panoramic views in this CORNER, Spacious, Sun filled 2 Bedrooms 2 Baths in MOST DESIRED Building in the heart of DOWNTOWN. Enjoy convenient living within easy walking distance to vibrant downtown, entertainment, restaurants and train & 1-95. Credit check is required .Small Cat is ok.
